Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Time of day: warm lamplight or candlelight indoors, the rest in shadow.
Outfit: swimwear with a light yukata worn open over it — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, rust, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — molybdenum: a hard silver-grey metal whose name comes from the Greek word for lead, because the soft, greasy black mineral molybdenite, which leaves a silvery streak on paper, was long confused with graphite and with lead ore; in 1778 it was boiled in nitric acid into a white earth that was neither, and in 1781 freed as metal; it melts above 2600 degrees Celsius, and a little of it keeps steel strong and unbending when hot, in bicycle frames, aircraft, turbines and gun barrels; one atom of it sits at the heart of the enzyme that pulls nitrogen from the air in the root nodules of beans and peas — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.
